CONCEPT V10 / REVIEW NOTES

A distinct perspective for
Bluzee.

A complete visual refresh designed around luminous environments, human perspective and purposeful movement.

Return to the homepage↗
IDEAS WITH PURPOSE. PROGRESS WITH PEOPLE.Scroll to explore↓

A visual identity for every offering.

Each offering has its own editorial image, with lighter blue daylight and distinct subjects. Decorative photographs are assigned to one location across the website; the original media archive and brand marks retain their source identities. Morphing contours, layered parallax, flowing signals and hover depth bring the imagery to life. Red sculptural spheres roll, bounce and rotate behind pale sections in response to scrolling, with a pause control and reduced-motion support. Deep navy editorial chapters alternate with luminous pale blue sections. The red U in the Bluzee logo, approved contact details and trademarks remain consistent.

Motion with intention

The homepage offers three visual perspectives, cursor-responsive water refraction, cinematic image reveals and an interactive private-AI showcase. Backgrounds respond to pointer movement and scrolling. The ERP guide opens as a three-dimensional folio, with four original PDF pages to explore and a download of the complete guide. Navigation uses a short, reduced-motion-aware curtain transition. Event galleries and participant recordings retain their native controls. No scroll hijacking is used. Short silent excerpts from existing workshop recordings can play when visible on desktop, with a pause control. Mobile and reduced-motion visitors can choose to play. Original recordings remain unchanged.

Real evidence, preserved

All original recordings, participant images, leadership portraits, source qualifications, brochure downloads and the ERP guide remain available. The working R2 media mapping is retained. Generated architecture and people are conceptual marketing imagery, not representations of actual Bluzee premises, clients, staff or events.

Built for the current hosting plan

The concept remains static HTML, CSS and JavaScript for Cloudflare Pages. Large recordings remain in R2. Local responsive WebP images reduce download weight. The interaction layer uses native CSS, JavaScript and a progressively enhanced 2D canvas; the site does not depend on WebGL. No paid animation service or additional framework is required.

Accessibility and performance

A visible Pause motion control is available. Reduced-motion preferences disable movement. Pointer effects are restricted to fine-pointer devices; offscreen scenes and hidden tabs stop animating. Controls remain available by keyboard and page content does not depend on animation.

Before production launch

Review this private concept before copying it to the public Pages repository. The existing launch recording and retained legacy pages still need migration before cancelling Wix. The enquiry form prepares an email draft; real form delivery, production media hostname, redirects and indexing remain separate launch tasks.
